description: ENTSO-E Germany-Spain Hourly Electricity Market Dataset (2021-2025), published by Akter, Ashrafi; Yousuf, Kayes Bin; Tanmoy, Sakib Nawar; Noor, Hadid Ahmed; Ahmed, Ashik, combines ENTSO-E demand, renewable generation, wholesale prices and residual load for a Germany-Spain study. Coverage: Germany and Spain during January 2021 to December 2025. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: The paper is described as submitted; neither acceptance nor independent reuse is established. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
